MapBop — Data deletion

Last updated: October 18, 2026

About game accounts

MapBop does not create a separate Oyri Games account in the current build. There is therefore no Oyri Games game account to delete. Local saves and any data sent to service providers are handled separately.

1. Delete local game data

On Android, clear app storage from your device settings or uninstall the app. On iOS, use Delete App; offloading the app may retain its data. This removes progress, settings, and local gameplay history. Manage separate backups and exported files independently.

2. Request removal of service data

If analytics or purchase services are enabled, removing the local app does not automatically delete their records. Include MapBop / WhereIsIt, your platform, and your installation ID if available. If you cannot access the ID, explain this; the ability to associate records must be reviewed.

Purchases and subscriptions

A data deletion request does not refund a store purchase or cancel a possible subscription. Manage those through your store account. Store transaction records follow the store’s own retention terms.
